edges: dense array; simple undirected graph, no self-loop or repeated unordered pair; weight integer −99…99; ignore extra record keys; copy from/to orientation exactly
ordering: ascending weight then original input array index
trace: one 1-based step for every sorted edge; accept iff separate before components; all snapshots detached and deeply frozen; sorted vertex groups ordered by smallest vertex; isolates included; decisions=edges.length
completion: minimum spanning tree when final components.length===1, otherwise one minimum tree per original component; n=1 empty graph is connected
parserGrammar: count trimmed single digit1–8; one nonblank line per edge, single case-insensitive ASCII endpoint letters and signed decimal integer weight separated by spaces/tabs; optional+/- and leading zeros; blank lines ignored; no commas/comments/exponents/decimals
inputImmutability: never mutate caller arrays or records, including additional record fields
